summary: Generated deployments restart the server after a crash
compatibility: Generated Compose files now use restart: on-failure and the README docker run examples pass --restart on-failure. A container stopped with docker stop, or one that fails within 10 s of starting, is not restarted. Existing deployments keep their own restart policy.
details: Since vllm #928 the server exits with status 1 within a second when its engine fails, for example after a CUDA out-of-memory error on one GPU, instead of hanging. With restart: no the container then stayed down; now Docker starts it again and LMCache restores conversations from its cache.
